EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Non Diagnostic Boundary

Non Diagnostic Boundary workflow for coding agents. Use when someone asks whether a response style proves ADHD.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. Answer no; describe the style as a reading preference and avoid diagnostic inference.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.

Populated example

Request: Does this style prove I have ADHD?

No. A writing preference does not diagnose ADHD.

Use the helper

non_diagnostic_response
